problem.title: Check If There Is A Valid Parentheses String Path

approaches.title: Set-based dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Tracks the set of possible balance values at each grid cell using rolling-column dynamic programming. Revision 1 is marked wrong; revision 2 adds validity checks and prevents negative balances.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial rolling DP using HashSet balance states, retaining states that can still reach the endpoint. Marked wrong.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2267: negative check and early exits
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Adds parity and endpoint early exits, and filters states to nonnegative balances within the remaining path distance.

approaches.title: Bitmask dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Replaces HashSet balance states with bitmasks, where each bit represents a reachable balance. This materially changes the state representation and improves the implementation's performance.

revisions.commitComment: bit mask approach for O(n) perf
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2267: bit mask approach for O(n) perf
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces HashSet state tracking with u128 bitmask propagation using shifts and unions.
